tasks.title: Establish the autonomous AI development loop
tasks.summary: Establish the repository-owned autonomous AI development loop: the .ai/ configuration, prompts, schemas and machine-readable state; the .openhands/skills/badminton-development skill; and the event-driven GitHub Actions workflows that implement the review -> fix -> merge -> next-task cycle. Infrastructure only - no product feature work.
acceptanceCriteria: `.ai/loop.config.json` declares maxReviewRounds, baseBranch, protectedPaths, requiredChecks, mergeGate, automation and label names, and validates against `.ai/schemas/loop-config.schema.json`.
`.ai/state/loop-state.json`, `.ai/state/task-queue.json` and `.ai/state/review-log.jsonl` validate against their schemas.
The review stage is ChatGPT (`.ai/scripts/chatgpt-review.mjs`) and never an OpenHands conversation.
The merge gate merges automatically only when the review is approved, required CI is green, the head SHA matches the approval and no protected path changed.
A successful merge automatically generates exactly one next task and dispatches its implementation.
Exactly one implementation task may be active at a time (`maxConcurrentTasks` is 1).
The existing CI workflow is unchanged and still runs lint, typecheck, test, build and e2e.
`npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` pass on the branch.
outOfScope: Merging any pull request by hand

tasks.title: Match result correction with downstream propagation (TASK-8, parity gap G6)
tasks.summary: A recorded result is currently immutable: MatchResultService.recordResult rejects a second completion and there is no reset. V1 lets an operator re-enter a score (saveGroupScore) and reset a match (resetMatch); the TASK-5 audit records the missing correction workflow as gap G6 and as the top remaining parity item. Add a guarded GROUP-match result-correction workflow: a completed group match can be re-scored in one atomic operation, so a mistyped score is fixed without touching the database. Standings and qualification are derived from the stored games, so they correct automatically. Correcting a knockout result (which requires bracket re-derivation) is out of scope and stays immutable.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/unit/domain/correction.test.ts passes: isMatchCorrectable is true for a COMPLETED group match (roundNumber/matchNumber null) and false for a completed knockout match (non-null bracket position) and for any non-COMPLETED match.

tests/unit/application/match-correction.service.test.ts passes: correcting a completed group match replaces the stored games, recomputes the winner and returns the new MatchResult; the corrected score is reflected by StandingsService.getStageStandings (points and point difference match the new result); a knockout match, a non-completed match and an illegal group score (31-29) are rejected with BusinessRuleViolationError; an unknown match id raises NotFoundError; a failure mid-correction leaves the original result, games and winner unchanged.
tests/unit/application/transaction-boundaries.test.ts records exactly one runInTransaction for correctResult and asserts recordResult is unchanged.

tests/integration/api/routes.test.ts (or a sibling API spec) asserts POST /api/v1/matches/:id/result/correction returns 201 with the new result for a completed group match, 422 for a knockout match, 404 for an unknown id and 400 for an empty games array.

apps/web/src/pages/tournaments/match-detail.test.tsx passes: the Correct result control is rendered for a completed group match and is absent for a completed knockout match; submitting the correction calls the correction endpoint.

e2e/result-correction.spec.ts passes against the real UI/API/PostgreSQL: score a group match 21-10, correct it to 21-19, assert the match stays COMPLETED and the group standings show the corrected points; assert a completed knockout match exposes no correction control.
No database migration, seed change or workflow change is introduced: the diff adds nothing under prisma/migrations/** and does not touch prisma/seed.ts or .github/workflows/ci.yml.
The realtime catalogue is unchanged: tests/unit/domain/realtime.test.ts (its exact-list assertion) passes without edits.
npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm test, npm run build and npm run test:e2e pass.
outOfScope: Correcting a knockout result and re-deriving the bracket (clearing the winner from the next round and un-completing downstream matches).
Export/import/reset of a whole tournament, court/stage deletion, scheduler parity, team levels and the other TASK-5 gaps (G7-G16).
Any new realtime event type, any second data-fetching framework, or any change to recordResult, MATCH_TRANSITIONS or MatchService.transitionStatus.
Production data, credentials, or a hand merge.

tasks.title: Knockout result correction with bracket re-derivation (TASK-9, parity gap G6)
tasks.summary: AI-002 made a GROUP result correctable and deliberately left a KNOCKOUT result immutable, because correcting one also requires re-deriving the bracket. docs/phase-6-knockout.md section 17 records a result-correction workflow as the top future extension point and the TASK-5 audit records the same as gap G6, noting V1's sourceA/sourceB re-derivation exists so a corrected earlier result flows downstream. This task completes G6: a completed knockout match becomes correctable through the existing POST /api/v1/matches/:id/result/correction endpoint, and the correction re-derives the bracket in one transaction - the immediate destination slot is re-filled with the new winner, any downstream match that was already decided is reset (winner and games cleared) because its participants changed, and a COMPLETED stage whose final is invalidated reopens to ACTIVE. Group correction is unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/unit/domain/correction.test.ts passes: isMatchCorrectable is true for a COMPLETED match in a GROUP stage and for a COMPLETED match in a KNOCKOUT stage (with and without a bracket position), and false for any non-COMPLETED match in either stage type.

tests/unit/application/knockout-correction.service.test.ts passes over the in-memory ports: for a 4-entry bracket, correcting the final re-derives nothing; correcting semifinal 1 re-fills the final's slot 1 with the new winner and, when the final was COMPLETED, resets it (winner cleared, games deleted) and reopens a COMPLETED stage to ACTIVE; for an 8-entry bracket, correcting quarterfinal 1 re-fills semifinal 1's slot 1 and, when semifinal 1 was COMPLETED, resets it and clears its old winner from the final's slot 1 (resetting the final too when it was COMPLETED), cascading in ascending round order; a destination already holding the new winner is a no-op; a corrected match with no bracket position or no drawSize re-derives nothing; a missing destination match raises BusinessRuleViolationError.

tests/unit/application/match-correction.service.test.ts is extended so correctResult accepts a completed knockout match, returns the new result, and leaves the old winner absent from the next round's slot (the destination now holds the new winner); the existing group cases still pass.
tests/unit/application/transaction-boundaries.test.ts records exactly one runInTransaction for a knockout correctResult and asserts recordResult is unchanged.

tests/integration/api/routes.test.ts asserts POST /api/v1/matches/:id/result/correction returns 201 with the new result for a completed knockout match (a 4-entry bracket, correcting a semifinal so the final's slot 1 changes and the final is reset), 422 for a non-completed match, 404 for an unknown id and 400 for an empty games array; the existing group-correction cases still pass unchanged.

apps/web/src/pages/tournaments/match-detail.test.tsx passes: the Correct result control is rendered for a completed knockout match and submitting it calls the correction endpoint (never the record endpoint); the group case still passes.

e2e/result-correction.spec.ts passes against the real UI/API/PostgreSQL: generate a 4-entry bracket, play both semifinals, play the final; correct a semifinal so the other competitor wins, assert the semifinal stays COMPLETED with the new winner, the final's slot 1 holds the new winner and the final is no longer COMPLETED (its stale result was reset); the existing group-correction assertions still pass and the read-only knockout assertion is replaced by the new correction behaviour.

No database migration, seed change or workflow change is introduced: the cascade reuses the existing matches, match_participants and match_games tables and the diff adds nothing under prisma/migrations/** and does not touch prisma/seed.ts or .github/workflows/ci.yml.

The realtime catalogue is unchanged: tests/unit/domain/realtime.test.ts (its exact-list assertion) passes without edits; the cascade reuses MATCH_RESULT_RECORDED, MATCH_COMPLETED, KNOCKOUT_MATCH_POPULATED and STAGE_STATUS_CHANGED.
npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm test, npm run build and npm run test:e2e pass.
outOfScope: A reset bracket / re-generate bracket route, or changing bracket size or first-round pairings after generation (the bracket stays generated-once).
An audit trail / correction history (V1 has none).
Any new realtime event type, any second data-fetching framework, any change to recordResult, MATCH_TRANSITIONS or MatchService.transitionStatus.
Export/import/reset of a whole tournament, court/stage deletion, scheduler parity, team levels and the other TASK-5 gaps (G7-G16).
Production data, credentials, or a hand merge.
